description: Fix RBAC bypass on individual record endpoints. The list endpoints (GET /api/tenant/deals, GET /api/tenant/tasks, GET /api/tenant/contacts) properly filter by assignedTo/createdBy when the user lacks view_all permission. But the individual GET endpoints (/api/tenant/deals/[id], /api/tenant/contacts/[id]) only check that the user has the basic 'view' permission and then return ANY record in the tenant. A regular user without deals.view_all can access any deal by guessing/knowing the UUID.
steps: In app/api/tenant/deals/[id]/route.ts GET handler (line ~17-67): After fetching the deal row, add an ownership check. If the user does NOT have 'deals.view_all' permission (check with can(ctx, 'deals.view_all')), verify that either deals.assignedTo === ctx.userId OR deals.createdBy === ctx.userId. If neither matches, return 404 (not 403 to avoid information disclosure). Import 'can' from '@/lib/auth/middleware'.

In app/api/tenant/contacts/[id]/route.ts GET handler (around line 17-73): Same pattern. After fetching the contact row, if the user does NOT have 'contacts.view_all' permission, verify contacts.assignedTo === ctx.userId OR contacts.createdBy is the user. Return 404 if not authorized. Need to import 'can' from middleware. Note: contacts table has createdBy column. The select should include createdBy if not already.

In app/api/tenant/tasks/[id]/route.ts: This file only has PATCH and DELETE. Check if there's a GET. If there's no individual GET for tasks, skip. The PATCH handler already scopes by tenantId which is good, but should also verify ownership. If user lacks tasks.edit_all, only allow editing own tasks.
acceptance_criteria: A user without deals.view_all permission cannot access a deal they are not assigned to or did not create via GET /api/tenant/deals/[id]
A user without contacts.view_all permission cannot access a contact they are not assigned to via GET /api/tenant/contacts/[id]
The endpoints return 404 (not 403) when access is denied to avoid revealing record existence
verification: Run: npx tsc --noEmit app/api/tenant/deals/[id]/route.ts app/api/tenant/contacts/[id]/route.ts app/api/tenant/tasks/[id]/route.ts 2>&1 | head -30
